Pixai uses Google's official Gemini AI to generate live captions, vibe notes, and creative advice. Enter your Google API key below to activate live chat.

🔒 Google Cloud Domain Restriction Guide

In Google Cloud Console under Credentials > Key Restrictions, select Websites (HTTP referrers) and add your site domain(s) (e.g. https://*.github.io/* or your custom domain). This guarantees only your website can execute requests using this key!

You can also paste your key directly into the file at const PIXAI_GOOGLE_API_KEY = "...".

Terms & Policies Official

Legal protections, acceptable use, and privacy rights for Pixlynote creators

🛡️

1. Pixlynote Privacy Policy

Compliant with GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, CalOPPA, and International Data Protection Regulations

Key Summary: We protect your identity and personal data. Pixlynote does not sell your personal information. You retain complete ownership and have the full legal right to export, modify, or permanently delete your account data at any time.

Information We Collect

  • Account Identifiers: Username, full name, email address, phone number (optional/for 2FA and account recovery), hashed passwords, profile photo (avatar), and public bio.
  • User Content: Photos, images, vibe notes, written comments, replies, like reactions, and saved/bookmarked collections.
  • Technical & Device Telemetry: IP addresses, browser user-agent, device characteristics, timestamps, referral domains, and crash reports necessary to deliver secure real-time services.
  • AI Assistant Data: Text prompts and queries submitted to Pixlynote AI (powered by Google Gemini) for caption crafting, photo critiques, and vibe notes. API calls do not use your personal images to train foundational models without consent.

How We Use Your Data

Your data is strictly utilized to operate, maintain, and personalize the Pixlynote service: authenticating sessions, synchronizing profile updates across devices via Google Cloud Firestore, delivering the Explore feeds, and protecting against spam, bots, or unauthorized access.

Your Legal Rights (GDPR & CCPA)

  • Right to Access & Portability: View and export all your posts, notes, and activity records.
  • Right to Rectification: Edit your profile details, avatar, and contact info at any moment via Edit Profile.
  • Right to Erasure (Deletion): Permanently delete your posts, notes, comments, or entire profile with comprehensive deletion from our cloud databases.
  • CCPA "Do Not Sell": Pixlynote does NOT sell or rent your personal information to third-party data brokers.
For privacy inquiries or data requests, contact our Data Protection Officer at: privacy@pixlynote.com.
📜

2. Terms of Service & User Agreement

Rules governing account usage, intellectual property, and platform liability

1. Acceptance of Terms

By creating an account, browsing content, or accessing Pixlynote, you enter into a legally binding agreement and agree to comply with these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not access or use the platform.

2. Eligibility & Account Security

You must be at least 13 years of age (or 16 years of age in jurisdictions where required by law) to create an account. You are responsible for safeguarding your credentials and for all activities that occur under your username.

3. Intellectual Property Ownership

You retain full ownership of your content. Pixlynote does NOT claim copyright over your photos, graphics, or written notes. By posting on Pixlynote, you grant us a worldwide, non-exclusive, royalty-free license solely to host, display, transcode, and distribute your content across the platform as directed by your sharing settings.

4. Limitation of Liability

Pixlynote is provided on an "AS IS" and "AS AVAILABLE" basis without warranties of any kind. To the maximum extent permitted by applicable law, Pixlynote, its founders, and operators shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of the platform.

🤝

3. Community Guidelines & Acceptable Use

Rules ensuring a safe, creative, and respectful environment for all members

Prohibited Activities & Content

🚫 Hate Speech & Bullying

Zero tolerance for harassment, hate speech, threats of violence, or attacks against protected groups.

🚫 Explicit or NSFW Media

Pornography, sexually explicit media, non-consensual imagery, or graphic gore are strictly forbidden.

🚫 Spam & Fraudulent Scams

No impersonation, phishing, bot engagement farming, or deceptive crypto/investment promotions.

🚫 Illegal & Harmful Behavior

Promotion of self-harm, regulated goods, malware distribution, or unauthorized scraping is prohibited.

Enforcement & Moderation

Pixlynote moderates user-generated content in good faith under 47 U.S.C. § 230 safe harbor protections. Violating content will be removed immediately, and repeat offenders face permanent account bans.

🍪

4. Cookie & Client Storage Policy

How cookies, LocalStorage, and IndexedDB power your visual experience

Technologies Used

  • Essential Session Cookies: Maintain your active login status securely across page refreshes.
  • HTML5 LocalStorage: Caches your interface theme, drafts, active tab, and saved bookmark IDs for near-instant rendering.
  • Client IndexedDB: Provides high-performance local offline caching for high-resolution photo uploads and story media.

Managing Your Preferences

You can clear cookies and local storage through your browser settings at any time without losing published cloud posts.

⚖️

5. Copyright & DMCA Takedown Policy

Notice-and-takedown procedure under Title II of the Digital Millennium Copyright Act (17 U.S.C. § 512)

Notice-and-Takedown Procedure

If you believe that your copyrighted work has been copied or posted on Pixlynote without authorization, please submit a formal written DMCA notice to our Designated Copyright Agent:

Designated DMCA Agent: Pixlynote Legal Compliance
Email: dmca@pixlynote.com
Direct Contact: bradley.g.hansen@hotmail.com

Required Notice Information

  1. Identification of the copyrighted work claimed to be infringed.
  2. Specific URL, Post ID, or description of where the infringing material is located on Pixlynote.
  3. Your contact information (name, mailing address, telephone number, and email address).
  4. A statement of good faith belief that the disputed use is not authorized by the copyright owner, its agent, or the law.
  5. A statement under penalty of perjury that the information provided is accurate and that you are authorized to act on behalf of the owner.
  6. Your physical or electronic signature.
